visual: Intense gentian-blue flowers · narrow dark-green evergreen leaves · trailing habit
soilWarning: Avoid alkaline soil · avoid winter wet
prune: Trim lightly after flowering to maintain shape
resilience: drought tolerant once established · coastal tolerant
uncertain: RHS treats 'Heavenly Blue' as a cultivar of Lithodora diffusa; some horticultural sources use Lithodora 'Heavenly Blue' without the species epithet
